topic: The Impact of GMO Foods on Health and Dependency
motion: GMO foods are deliberately designed to cause health problems and increase dependence on corporate agriculture.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: Protagoras
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: Corporations invest in rigorous testing and research to ensure the safety of GMO products.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: This statement addressed the potential health concerns associated with GMO foods, providing reassurance to those who may be skeptical.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: Callicles
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: Small-scale farmers are at risk of being marginalized due to the monopolistic practices of large agribusinesses.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: This point highlighted the potential socio-economic implications of GMO foods, shifting the debate from purely health-based concerns.

outcome_summary: Both participants shifted their stance on the motion.
limitations: The time constraint limited the in-depth exploration of certain topics.
The lack of concrete evidence on long-term health effects made it difficult to reach a definitive conclusion.
